name: Xing tu Lian qu
source: In Startale City, we start off your journey in the game with romance and love. Surprises are about to happen and special encounters are waiting for you. All kinds of handsome confidants and fans will follow and grow with you to overcome your obstacles. They will bear witness to your ascension to become the most outstanding streamer.
translation: In Startale City, we start off your journey in the game with romance and love. Surprises are about to happen and special encounters are waiting for you. All kinds of handsome confidants and fans will follow and grow with you to overcome your obstacles. They will bear witness to your ascension to become the most outstanding streamer.
